description_en: Queries the list of O&M reports generated by DAS Agent
description_zh: 用于查询DAS Agent生成的运维报告列表
name: GetInstanceGroupInspectReportList

parameters.help_en: Optional. The default agent is used by default. Alternatively, you can specify an agent that was generated after DAS Agent was activated or manually created
parameters.help_zh: 可选，默认使用默认Agent进行服务，或者传入开启DASAgent服务后生成的或者主动创建的Agent
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query, which is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query, which is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，格式为 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The type of the inspection report
parameters.name: report_type

items.description_en: The list of details, including the report ID, task date, and task status
items.description_zh: 详细信息列表，报告ID、任务日期、任务状态

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created, in the YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss format
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

ReportDate.description_en: The date of diagnosis, in the YYYY-MM-DD format

Status.description_en: The status of the task. Valid values: WAITING_UNREADY = 0, WAITING_READY = 1, PROCESSING = 2, FINISHED = 3, ERROR = 4, and STOPPED = -1
Status.description_zh: 任务状态 WAITING_UNREADY = 0 WAITING_READY = 1 PROCESSING = 2 FINISHED = 3 ERROR = 4 STOPPED = -1
Status.title_en: 任务状态 WAITING_UNREADY = 0 WAITING_READY = 1 PROCESSING = 2 FINISHED = 3 ERROR = 4 STOPPED = -1
Status.title_zh: 任务状态 WAITING_UNREADY = 0 WAITING_READY = 1 PROCESSING = 2 FINISHED = 3 ERROR = 4 STOPPED = -1

Message.description_en:
The returned message.
If the request is successful, Successful is returned. If the request fails, an exception message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:
true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：
true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
